{{Top|leg}}
'''Emergency condition 292''' was a security condition which could be issued by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] planet of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in case of a breakout. Around [[3641 BBY]], the traitorous [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]], [[S. Geland]], declared the emergency condition when trying to stop the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] from reaching the imprisoned [[Esh-kha]] [[Hallow Voice]]. In response to S. Geland's orders, two [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] arrived at the scene to assist Geland, but the Barsen'thor defeated them and the commander.
